home.title: WFTools — Free Online Tools

home.lead: Pick a tool and use it right in your browser. No sign-up, and your data never leaves your device.

image.name: Image Tools
image.desc: Compress, convert, remove backgrounds and watermark images on your device.

file.name: File Tools
file.desc: Merge/split PDFs, convert PowerPoint, compare text and convert data.

business.name: Online Business
business.desc: Tools for online shops, small businesses and freelancers.

finance.name: Finance & Calculators
finance.desc: Accurate calculations by formula and current regulations.

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.desc: QR codes, campaign links and brand colors.

health.name: Health
health.desc: Track weight, nutrition, water, activity and cycle.

edu.name: Education & Teaching
edu.desc: Timetables, quizzes, attendance, mind maps and pay.

time.name: Time Tools
time.desc: Clocks, countdowns, time zones, working days and journal.

dev.name: Developer Tools
dev.desc: Format, lint, encrypt and convert source code.

image-convert.name: Compress Image
image-convert.desc: Reduce image file size and shrink many images at once for faster web upload and email.

image-format.name: Convert Image Format
image-format.desc: Convert images between JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP and ICO (favicon) for websites, apps or storage.

image-base64.name: Image to Base64
image-base64.desc: Turn images into Base64 strings to embed in HTML, CSS or code, and convert Base64 back to images.

bg-remove.name: Remove Image Background
bg-remove.desc: Remove a white or solid-color background from product photos, logos and avatars, instantly on your device.

watermark.name: Add Watermark to Images
watermark.desc: Add text, a logo or a copyright mark to one or many images at once.

pdf-merge.name: Merge & Split PDF
pdf-merge.desc: Combine several PDF files into one, extract the pages you need, or split a PDF page by page.

pptx-pdf.name: PowerPoint ↔ PDF
pptx-pdf.desc: Convert PowerPoint (.pptx) slides to PDF and turn PDF files into PowerPoint.

file-diff.name: Compare Two Files
file-diff.desc: Find the differences between two texts: TXT, Word, HTML or text-based PDF. Added, removed and changed parts are highlighted.

text-analysis.name: Text Analysis
text-analysis.desc: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs, estimate reading time and keyword density for text, TXT, Word or PDF files.

data-convert.name: Convert JSON, XML, CSV, Excel
data-convert.desc: Convert data between JSON, XML, CSV and Excel (.xlsx) with a table preview.

bmi-bmr.name: BMI & BMR Calculator
bmi-bmr.desc: Calculate body mass index (BMI), waist-hip ratio and calorie needs (BMR, TDEE) by age, sex and activity level.

meal-calo.name: Daily Meal & Calorie Planner
meal-calo.desc: Plan meals by a calorie goal, look up calories of common dishes and balance protein, carbs and fat.

water-tracker.name: Water Intake Tracker
water-tracker.desc: Set a daily goal and log how much water you drink, with progress and a multi-day history.

calo-burn.name: Calories Burned by Activity
calo-burn.desc: Estimate calories burned by sport, activity, duration and body weight using MET values.

cycle-track.name: Menstrual Cycle Tracker
cycle-track.desc: Log and predict your menstrual cycle, ovulation day and fertile window. Data stays only on your device.

study-timetable.name: Study Timetable
study-timetable.desc: Build a weekly class timetable by period; print it or save it to reuse every day.

quiz-bank.name: Quiz & Question Bank
quiz-bank.desc: Create a multiple-choice question bank, shuffle questions, take a graded practice test, and print the exam and answer key.

attendance.name: Attendance
attendance.desc: Build a class roster, take attendance per session and track absences and late arrivals. Can sync to Google Sheets.

mindmap.name: Mind Map & Summary
mindmap.desc: Draw mind maps for lessons and automatically summarize long text into key points.

teaching-pay.name: Teaching Hours & Pay
teaching-pay.desc: Log teaching sessions, total the hours and pay by rate, and export a statement.

fullscreen-clock.name: Fullscreen Clock
fullscreen-clock.desc: A large fullscreen digital clock with stopwatch and countdown, customizable colors, font and 12/24-hour format.

countdown-video.name: Countdown Video Maker
countdown-video.desc: Create a customizable countdown timer and download it as a video to drop into your clips.

world-clock.name: World Clock
world-clock.desc: See the current time in many countries at once and compare time-zone differences between them.

workdays.name: Working Days Calculator
workdays.desc: Count the working days between two dates, excluding Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.

journal.name: Online Journal
journal.desc: Write a daily journal saved privately to your own Google Sheet, readable only by you.

code-format.name: Format JS, HTML, CSS, JSON
code-format.desc: Neatly indent and tidy up JavaScript, HTML, CSS and JSON code.

code-check.name: Syntax Checker
code-check.desc: Find syntax and structure errors in JavaScript, HTML, CSS and JSON, with line and column.

js-obfuscate.name: JavaScript Obfuscator
js-obfuscate.desc: Encode strings, rename variables and obfuscate JavaScript to make it hard to read and copy.

rsa-keys.name: RSA Keys & Encryption
rsa-keys.desc: Generate an RSA key pair (PEM), encrypt text with the public key and decrypt with the private key, all on your device.

text-to-html.name: Rich Text to HTML
text-to-html.desc: Edit visually with bold, headings, lists, tables and links, and get clean HTML code.

inventory.name: Inventory & Pricing
inventory.desc: Set selling prices from marketplace fees, ads and margin. Track stock in and out with low-stock alerts.

invoice.name: Invoice & Quote
invoice.desc: Create quotes and sales invoices with a logo, auto totals and amount in words. Print or save as PDF.

menu-qr.name: QR Menu
menu-qr.desc: Create a digital menu for restaurants and cafes. Customers scan a QR code to view dishes and prices.

barcode.name: Barcode Generator
barcode.desc: Generate Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A and Code 39 barcodes for product and warehouse labels.

loan.name: Loan Calculator
loan.desc: Monthly payment, total interest and a repayment schedule for home, car and consumer loans.

compound.name: Compound Interest & Savings
compound.desc: Project how much you accumulate with regular monthly savings or investments.

salary.name: Gross ↔ Net Salary
salary.desc: Convert Gross to Net salary and back, following 2026 insurance and personal income tax rules (Vietnam).

qr-code.name: QR Code Generator
qr-code.desc: Create QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi, email and phone numbers. Download as PNG or SVG.

utm.name: UTM Link Builder
utm.desc: Add campaign tracking codes to links to see which channel your visitors come from.

colors.name: Color Palette & Codes
colors.desc: Build a harmonious palette from a base color and get HEX, RGB, HSL codes and CSS variables.

expense.name: Expense & Budget
expense.desc: Log daily income and expenses, view spending by category and set limits to stay on budget.

habit.name: Habit & Streak Tracker
habit.desc: Mark habits each day and track consecutive-day streaks to stay disciplined.

cv.name: Resume (CV) Builder
cv.desc: Fill in a template with live preview, pick a layout and color, and print or save as PDF for free.

currency-time.name: Currency & Time Zones
currency-time.desc: Convert currencies at the latest rates and check the time in cities around the world.
